messages:
sara: heads up — after the RBAC role rename landed in prod at 08:05 we started seeing sporadic idp-sync failures. SCIM create/update calls are returning 429s and some user events are not showing up in the audit stream. looking into whether this is throttling or a mapping edge-case :thinking:
liam: saw the alerts too, spike in 429s from the idp endpoint around 08:07. can you paste the error payload?
sara: log snippet:
```
2026-03-20T08:07:12Z ERROR scim.sync request_id=abc123 status=429 body={"error":"rate_exceeded","retry_after":30}
2026-03-20T08:07:13Z WARN rbac.apply user=svc-scim role=project_editor -> role not found
```
ida: the role rename is part of the rollout — we removed `project_editor` and replaced with `proj-editor-v2`. looks like some legacy provisioning jobs still use the old name.
devsec-paul: two things to check: 1) KMS envelope signature failures can cause retries that look like rate-limits in downstream logs, 2) audit pipeline drops if event signer timestamp differs >5s (we saw this in staging last week). can anyone confirm if any key rotations happened around the deploy?
sara: no KMS rotations scheduled. ops-bot: deploy-bot reports config commit `deploy/infra/2026-03-20-0800` applied at 08:04 by ida. includes RBAC mapping change.
liam: quick curl from our side reproduces 429. headers show `Retry-After: 30`. payload includes tenant externalId and old role name. we should prevent the old role from being accepted by SCIM server gracefully.
ida: ack. I can put a compatibility shim in the mapping service to remap `project_editor` -> `proj-editor-v2` for 48 hours. will that help the audit gaps?
devsec-paul: shim helps for provisioning but doesn't fix missing historical events. for audit pipeline, check the signer logs at kms-proxy and the event-ingest lambda. if events were dropped at the signer due to timestamp drift, they won't show up downstream. run `kms-proxy logs --since 1h --grep signer` and share results.
sara: running that now, grabbing logs...
(small pause)
sara: kms-proxy shows one `InvalidSignature` at 08:06:58 for request_id=abc117, then a bunch of `Retry` attempts. majority are `rate_exceeded` afterwards.
liam: sounds like a transient KMS hiccup timed with the rollout. Could be the signing client retried and tripped the IdP rate limits.
devsec-paul: mitigation plan: 1) temporarily enable role name remap (ida), 2) increase SCIM client-side backoff jitter and switch to exponential retry for the next 10 minutes (liam), 3) replay missing signer events from kms-proxy to event-ingest for any request_ids that failed (sara + infra), 4) post-mortem and update runbook on key rotation vs RBAC push ordering.
ida: starting shim now, will post when live.
liam: patching client backoff policy in the scim-worker; rolling patch to canary 1/4.
sara: creating a short incident ticket and tagging infra and compliance. Incident: INC-2026-042 — idp-sync + audit-drop during RBAC rename. adding logs and initial timeline.
devsec-paul: also check that audit storage received any partial batches — if we can recover partials we might avoid full replay. run `audit-store list --from 1710922000 --to 1710923000 --filter signer_failed`
sara: noted. filing the replay job once we confirm request_ids.
ida: shim live at 08:18 — remapping applied. early telemetry shows drops in 429s.
liam: canary backoff patch succeeded, 0/1 errors on canary. promoting.
ops-bot: automated alert cleared for scim-429-spike at 08:22.
sara: status update: scim error rate back to baseline, audit pipeline catching up with replay jobs queued, no evidence of data exfiltration. compliance loop-in okayed replay.
devsec-paul: good. follow-ups: add a pre-deploy check for active KMS operations and block RBAC renames during key maintenance windows, add mapping fallback in provisioning service, and add a health-check that correlates signer errors with downstream 429s. assigning owners in the ticket.
ida: will add the fallback PR and the deploy blocker check.
liam: will add the client backoff test and dashboard.
sara: thanks everyone. closing the incident when replay finishes and logs look clean. :thumbsup:
